content:
aliya: Quick proposal — unify quota decisions at Catalog (single source of truth) and make Gateway defer to it with a local read-through cache. Main reasons: reduces config drift, simplifies fairness rules, central telemetry.

ben: Sounds sensible but perf question. Gateway is hot path at 10k rps. Cache miss penalty must be tiny.

carla: Agree with ben. We'll need edge cache with <10ms median miss handling. Also consider conservative TTL + push invalidation for admin changes.

sam: How do we handle outages of Catalog? Gateway fallback?

aliya: Plan: (1) read-through LRU cache in gateway with per-tenant TTL (default 5s) (2) async push invalidation via a light SSE channel for critical policy changes (3) degrade to local static policy when Catalog unreachable, with exponential backoff attempts and circuit open metric.

ben: Cache sketch:
```
cache.get(key) -> if hit return
else fetch catalog -> cache.set(key, value, ttl)
```
We should batch fetches for tenant bursts (coalesce requests).

carla: Invalidation: SSE is good but we should also support a control-plane push via pubsub for Dedicated/private installs. Keep channels pluggable.

sam: Data model concerns — we need versioned policy blobs and an 'effective_until' to avoid races during rollouts.

aliya: Agreed. Policy blob fields: {version, effective_from, effective_until, ruleset_hash}. Gateway will accept only monotonic version updates.

ben: Telemetry: record cache_hit, cache_miss, catalog_latency, fallback_used, policy_version. Add per-tenant histograms.

carla: Rollout plan:
- canary 1% traffic to catalog-eval path with local cache bypass
- monitor error/fallback metrics for 24h
- increase 10x each day if stable
- enable SSE invalidation after stable

aliya: Migration: export current gateway rules to catalog via a migration job. Add a compatibility shim that serves old keys until cutover, TTL 1m during migration window.

sam: Failure modes checklist:
- Catalog 5xx spikes -> gateway falls back to last-known policy and throttles if unknown
- Invalidation storms -> gateways queue updates and apply rate-limit
- Version mismatch -> gateway rejects older versions with log+metric

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: eng-platform -> Tue 10:00 UTC :rocket:

ben: Notes: add integration test that simulates catalog outage with sustained 1k rps and verify tail latency <50ms.

carla: I'll own SSE implementation + pubsub adapter. @ben you take batching/coalescing and perf tests. @aliya will own migration job.

aliya: Thanks. I'll open RFC PR with this plan and rough diagrams. If no objections by EOD I'll start the canary.

ben: +1

sam: +1

carla: :thumbsup:
